signal: Kinective (formerly NXTsoft) has been on an acquisition run, recently buying ESQ Data Solutions, Datava, Epic River, and Janusea, now serving 4,000+ financial institution clients

email.body1:
Jennifer, saw Kinective has been stacking acquisitions, ESQ, Datava, Epic River, Janusea, now serving 4,000+ financial institutions.

Folding in that many products and customers usually means more cross-sell and in-market accounts than the team can work, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Kinective off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jennifer, quick follow-up for Kinective.

Post-acquisition, the cross-sell map gets big fast, and most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to work it all. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Kinective needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jennifer, last bit of proof for Kinective.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Kinective's reply rate likely compares to other fintech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jennifer, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating a string of acquisitions is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Kinective either way.
